B-104.command: set -euo pipefail; test "${OWNER_APPROVED_PROBE:?set OWNER_APPROVED_PROBE=1 for authenticated missing-path timing}" = 1; export D03_SAMPLE_COUNT=10; : > artifacts/d03/B104-missing-path-timing.json; for ordinal in $(seq 1 10); do curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out "sample=$ordinal HTTP status=%{http_code} wall_ms=%{time_total} missing=true\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CORELINK_PROD_TOKEN:?}" "$CORELINK_PROD_BASE/v1/does-not-exist-$ordinal" | tee -a artifacts/d03/B104-missing-path-timing.json; done; git --version | tee -a artifacts/d03/B104-missing-path-timing.json; stats_file="$(mktemp)"; awk -F'wall_ms=' '/wall_ms=/{split($2,a," "); print a[1]}' artifacts/d03/B104-missing-path-timing.json | sort -n | awk 'BEGIN {n=0} {v[++n]=$1} END {if (n < 10) exit 1; rank=0.9*(n-1)+1; lo=int(rank); frac=rank-lo; print "median_ms=" ((v[int((n+1)/2)] + v[int((n+2)/2)]) / 2) " p90_ms=" (v[lo] + frac*(v[lo+1]-v[lo]))}' > "$stats_file"; stats="$(cat "$stats_file")"; test -n "$stats"; cat "$stats_file" >> artifacts/d03/B104-missing-path-timing.json; rm -f "$stats_file"; grep -Fq 'missing=true' artifacts/d03/B104-missing-path-timing.json; grep -Eq 'median_ms=[0-9.]+ p90_ms=[0-9.]+' <<<"$stats"; grep -Fq 'version' artifacts/d03/B104-missing-path-timing.json
